about_the_game:
This pack includes:
- Mazda RX-8 Pearl Edition
- 45,000 Crew Credits

The Mazda RX-8 is one of the most iconic cars ever produced, ideal for beginners and the perfect canvas for the most inspired creators from all over the globe. Leave your mark on the leaderboards with this amazing car and its exclusive livery only available in The Crew® 2. Want more? This pack also includes 45,000 Crew Credits available for you to fulfill your collector's dream!
